phases.goal: Place the red block at the center as the base.
phases.name: place_red_base
phases.verify: Red block is stable and reachable as support.

phases.goal: Place the green block atop the red block.
phases.name: place_green_top
phases.verify: Green is supported on red without toppling.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Red block is the bottom support.
Green block is placed on top of red.

roles.manipulated_order: red block base, green block top
roles.protected: red base remains stable while green is placed

task_language: Set red block and green block at the center, stacking green block atop red block.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=3,use_length=50); 3:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid treating a closed gripper as a green-block hold; verify green lifts and keep the red base stable before placing green on top.
